# CANDIDATE: VWAP_MEAN_REV_ORB_FADE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price tends to revert to VWAP after a failed opening‑range breakout, offering a short edge. When SPY breaks above the opening‑range high (ORH) in the first 30 minutes but fails to sustain and closes below the 5‑minute VWAP before 10:45 ET, the mean‑reversion tendency provides a short‑biased setup.

## Mechanism

Entry: If price breaks above ORH within the first 30 minutes (09:30‑10:00 ET) and then closes below the 5‑minute VWAP before 10:45 ET, enter a short at the close of that bar. Exit: Initial chart‑stop at ORH; initial target at VWAP level (or 1R, whichever is reached first). If trade moves favorably (price < entry), trail stop with chandelier exit (ATR×2) to capture runner. Regime filters: VIX between 12‑22, ribbon slope < 0.05% per minute (avoid strong trend days), and avoid high‑impact news/FOMC windows.
